ship_audit.tenancy: n/a by construction — it edits the chapter open in the caller's own editor.

It is a FRONTEND tool in the always-on core, so it is advertised on every pass of every turn: it cannot lose a hot-seed slot and cannot be gated out. It was in front of the model the whole time.
